title: GPU rendering throughput bottleneck
fix_rationale: The trace shows the GPU frame duration exceeded CPU thread workloads. Inspecting resolution scaling, Lumen GI, Virtual Shadow Maps, and Nanite pass times with the GPU profiler helps identify the heaviest rendering stages.
evidence_template: {timer} took {ms} ms ({share}% of excess time), outlasting CPU thread workloads.

fixes.text: Enable or tune Dynamic Resolution / Temporal Super Resolution (r.ScreenPercentage) for your target framerate.
Review Lumen and Reflection scalability settings in Project Settings.
Optimize shadow-casting lights and Virtual Shadow Map (VSM) resolution limits.

verify: Adjust screen percentage or shadow quality and verify that GPU frame duration decreases proportionally.
